[[Enchanted Shield]]s are [[Warrior]] NPCs, found in [[Bloodstone Caves]], who "protect" various [[Ettin]]. They resemble a floating [[shield]] and [[sword]], and immediately disappear upon the death of the enemy they are protecting. 

They use [[Protector's Defense]] to protect their charge, though this can quickly be ended by sidestepping around the to force them to move.
